PricesResponse.description: Time differentiated prices for a price component.

unit.description: Unit for the price rate (e.g., kW, kWh) for each entry in the actual and preview price lists. Can represent average power over a fixed interval (e.g., 4 kW over 15 min) or equivalent energy consumption within that interval (e.g., 1 kWh per 15 min).

actual.description: Confirmed prices published by the DSO. Covers as much of the requested time range as available, starting from `fromIncluding`. Must be present; may be empty if no actual prices exist for the period.

preview.description: Estimated or forecasted prices that fill the time after the last actual price up to `toExcluding`, or until no more preview prices are available. Omitted or empty when all prices in the range are actual, or when no preview prices exist.

PriceListEntry.description: A timed price entry that belongs to a price list.

CostFunction.description: A pseudo code function that describes how to calculate the cost for a set of price components. Check DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md for usage examples (https://github.com/RI-SE/Eltariff-API/blob/main/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md)

Currency.description: The currency for all related prices.
